episodes.name: Raven
episodes.plot: When her sister Rosie goes missing after arriving at their grandfather's home, Zoe scours the area, meets some locals and has a scary encounter.

episodes.name: Rivals
episodes.plot: When rival riding school Holloway steals Bright Fields' recently won County Cup, Zoe and Pin must steal it back before Mia's press interview begins.

episodes.name: Golden Boy
episodes.plot: The gang sees Pin in a new light. On his last day, Marcus confesses a guilty secret to Rosie. Becky says a heartfelt goodbye to her longtime crush.

episodes.name: Maid of the Island
episodes.plot: Things get out of hand during a jousting match at the annual Maid of the Island tournament when Zoe and Mia face off against Gaby from Holloway.

episodes.name: Truth or Dare
episodes.plot: At a beach party, a game of truth or dare forces Zoe to face her feelings for Pin, and a horse race on the sand leads her to betray Raven's trust.

episodes.name: Sweet 16
episodes.plot: At Zoe's 16th birthday bash, Gaby stirs up trouble between Pin and Marcus, Rosie plays matchmaker, and Mia gathers proof of Callum's bad behavior.

episodes.name: Runaway
episodes.plot: Zoe takes Raven to a private spot to win his forgiveness. Becky, Ben and Rosie stumble upon a mysterious discovery. Mia overhears an upsetting chat.

episodes.name: Bob
episodes.plot: A fire brings an unlikely hero to the rescue. Gaby reveals her painful past to Zoe and Pin. Jade comes through for Becky during a time of need.

episodes.name: Gaby
episodes.plot: Gaby secretly trains on Raven, but Zoe's kindness makes her feel guilty. Rosie and Ben hunt for treasure in the tunnels. Pin makes plans with his mom.

episodes.name: Road Trip
episodes.plot: After Zoe and Pin miss the ferry to Nationals, they get a ride in Grandpa Frank's van. But an empty gas tank leads to an unplanned stop at a fair.

episodes.name: Nationals
episodes.plot: At Nationals, Pin does things his way, Becky cures Jade's fear of performing, Rosie uncovers an old family secret, and James tries to sabotage Raven.

episodes.name: Wild Horses
episodes.plot: The arrival of Zoe's mischievous cousin complicates the Bright Fields gang's attempts to impress the new mayor.

episodes.name: Hunted
episodes.plot: Pin leads the charge to find a skittish wild horse before the mayor does. The first Breakfast Club meeting leaves some riders champing at the bit.

episodes.plot: The gang gallops into action after inviting the mayor to tea at the castle. As they train for tryouts, Zoe and Gaby grow increasingly competitive.

episodes.plot: Bright Fields prepares to welcome a new four-legged guest, but Gaby's rivalry with Zoe could put the highly anticipated arrival at risk.

episodes.name: Pony Safari
episodes.plot: When Winnie's snobby schoolmates show up at Pony Camp, Zoe does everything possible to keep them busy. Meanwhile, Marcus pushes Mia to face her fears.

episodes.plot: Gaby's need to win at tryouts jeopardizes her friendship with Zoe. Jade seeks answers when she loses track of the wild horses.

episodes.plot: As Zoe and her friends narrow down the list of suspects in their search for the wild horses, Pin becomes more and more unwell.

episodes.plot: Jade and Becky go sleuthing at the castle, Zoe makes a decision about her future, and Callum's obnoxious behavior gets on Gaby's nerves.

overview.value: Una quindicenne di Los Angeles trascorre l'estate sull'isola al largo delle coste britanniche in cui è cresciuta la madre e si affeziona a un misterioso cavallo.

translations.overview: Una quindicenne di Los Angeles trascorre l'estate sull'isola al largo delle coste britanniche in cui è cresciuta la madre e si affeziona a un misterioso cavallo.
A 15-year-old from LA spends the summer at her mom's childhood home on an island off the coast of England, where she bonds with a mysterious horse.
